original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

actual_scope: Exhibit source-compatible T16 class marginals passing every joint-width rectangle cut but lacking a bin-level realization; supply a valid nonrectangular cell-neighborhood cut and feasible same-pattern control.
scope_change_reason: The drawn packing card permits a named bounded instance or exact relaxation. PR2535 explicitly asks what colored realization obstruction remains; this resolves that implication rather than searching another owner-map seed.
bottleneck_link: Prevents class-level packing search from interpreting necessary aggregate cuts as a physical realization; a stronger reusable cut can exclude a concrete false candidate without banning its pattern.
stop_rule: One exact source class counterexample, general valid inequality, complete bounded arithmetic/realization controls and source-model CLI; no broader packing search or performance claim.
evidence: README proof, source-bound RESULT, direct rectangle subset enumeration, complete 54-assignment census, same-pattern positive realization, cell-neighborhood coefficients and independent finite coefficient oracle.
author: ywz65
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate agent proof/source review and independent replay. No human or formal-kernel verification.

open_questions.question: Can violated nonrectangular cuts be found cheaply during the actual class optimizer?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A supplied-cell checker is not a complete separator or a benchmarked optimizer improvement.
open_questions.first_step: Retain an actual failing stage1 candidate, search a bounded set of sparse cell supports and compare identical optimizer settings with and without these cuts.
open_questions.blocked_by: No automatic large-class separation or search-speed benchmark is supplied.

open_questions.question: Do further realization obstructions survive these cuts?
open_questions.first_step: Retain a concrete passing marginal and compare it to exact bin-level realization.
